title: Sampling and repeat-penalty defaults per model family
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. repeat_penalty, repeat_last_n and max_generation_tokens come from the model's metadata/family table instead of global constants. Tests zc_generation_defaults_*.
